description.value: Uncle Willy's Buffet is a long-established all-you-can-eat buffet restaurant in Burnaby, famous for their fried chicken and roast beef that has been on the menu since the 1980s. The rotating daily menu spans a wide variety of dishes including fresh-made wontons, sweet and sour pork, roast chicken, and Friday-night sushi, making it a hearty calorie-replenishment stop for cyclists. The restaurant also offers takeout and hosts private parties with catering.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (7 spaces, covered) at 66m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully loaded and confirms an active, established buffet restaurant with a takeout menu page, food gallery, and party/catering services. The food gallery page references roast beef served since the 1980s, confirming long-standing operation. Most Squarespace subpages (About, Contact) rendered only navigation chrome with no body content, so phone and address cannot be confirmed from the website, and no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Multiple Squarespace subpages (Contact/Hours, About) rendered with no body content — likely JavaScript-rendered content that the prefetcher could not capture. Phone number and physical address are unconfirmed from the website.
Unit number (100) present in OSM addr:unit tag but omitted from the canonical address field in the OSM record; may affect wayfinding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, established restaurant well-suited as a cyclist refueling stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed because the website's key subpages (Contact, About) rendered only navigation chrome. An on-the-ground check or direct contact would resolve the required criteria and support a full include.
